mobile.name: CAMERA_MOBILE
mobile.parallax: none (ORTHO: a lateral move would slide the composition instead of creating parallax)

depth_cue_visible_and_bounded.note: apparent projected diameter per consecutive pair. Not every companion swims toward the camera: the one whose arc crosses the view plane changes depth least (measured 0.6%), so the contract is that each step shows a clear change somewhere and every node changes at all - which is what the card's depth cue actually asks for

rig_keys_carry_the_states.note: poses read back out of the animation system at scene frames 1-4

sequence_min_form_gap.note: projected silhouette gap between forms, scaled to the real page slot: a sequence must not let two nodes visually collide

pivot.note: RIG_ROOT origin; frame 01 is unaffected by construction because the offset term is (I - R)·P and R is the identity at rest

safe_regions.note: desktop: left strip of the art frame, kept clear so the HTML text column beside the frame never touches the object; mobile: top and bottom margins, because the graph sits between content blocks

state_transforms.intent: initial Home state; identical to the look lock
state_transforms.label: rest (the approved Stage 2.7 composition)

state_transforms.intent: small but visible depth change; one companion forward, one back
state_transforms.label: early rotation

state_transforms.intent: strongest 3D and parallax distinction, still calm
state_transforms.label: mid / strongest depth

state_transforms.intent: another meaningful viewing angle; not a return to frame 01
state_transforms.label: settled reveal
